n9177c2cfe22.s:
Consider the following statements about warming since 1900:
1. India has warmed by about 0.7°C.
2. India has warmed more than global land areas.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n9177c2cfe22.x: India has warmed about 0.7°C since 1900, whereas global land areas have warmed about 1.59°C, so India has warmed less, not more.

n803fef95cd1.s: Volcanic eruptions cause short-term cooling mainly because ____ and ash form aerosols that reflect sunlight.
n803fef95cd1.x: Sulphur dioxide and ash generate cooling aerosols that reflect incoming sunlight.

nef61703500c.s: Which of the following pairs (IPCC Working Group – subject) is correctly matched?
o: Working Group II – Physical science basis
Working Group III – Impacts, adaptation and vulnerability
nef61703500c.x: Working Group III deals with mitigation; Working Group I covers the physical science basis and Working Group II impacts, adaptation and vulnerability.

n3a13bc41720.s: Warmer and wetter conditions can widen the geographical range of which category of diseases?
o: Vector-borne diseases such as malaria and dengue
n3a13bc41720.x: Warmer and wetter conditions can expand the range of vectors and thereby increase the spread of malaria and dengue.

n5742c1da968.s:
Consider the following statements about climate tipping points:
1. The 1.2°C threshold for warm-water coral reef collapse has already been crossed.
2. Beyond about 2°C, parts of the Amazon could turn into a carbon sink.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n5742c1da968.x: The 1.2°C coral threshold has already been crossed. Beyond about 2°C parts of the Amazon could shift towards savanna and become a carbon source, not a sink.

nf4970252a97.s: In marine cloud brightening, sea-salt spray mainly acts as:
nf4970252a97.x: Sea-salt spray can act as cloud condensation nuclei, potentially making marine clouds brighter.

n9298f220ab0.s: The measurement of ocean depth and the mapping of the sea floor is called:
n9298f220ab0.x: Bathymetry is the measuring of ocean depth and the study and mapping of the sea floor (APPSC GS 2018); hypsometry relates to the share of surface at each height and depth.

ne8f4376e74c.s: Oceans absorb about what share of the excess heat from current global warming?
ne8f4376e74c.x: Oceans take up more than 90% of the excess heat; ocean heat content reached a record in 2025.

nphysics-19-33.s: Which of the following pairs (SONAR application – field) is correctly matched?
nphysics-19-33.x: SONAR locates fish shoals for the fishing industry; submarine detection is its military use and depth measurement relates to ocean depth.

nbc0f32fcb54.s: The deep sea below about 200 metres is described as Earth's:
nbc0f32fcb54.x: The deep sea below 200 m is the oldest and largest biome, occupying about 90–95 per cent of Earth's habitable space.

n42ce82f3d08.x: Oceanic trenches commonly occur at subduction zones, where one plate descends beneath another.

nbc66e5b6422.s: Which islands rise above parts of the S-shaped Mid-Atlantic Ridge?
nbc66e5b6422.x: The Mid-Atlantic Ridge is S-shaped, and Iceland and the Azores rise above parts of it.

n41edf327757.s:
Consider the following statements about red clay:
1. It is the most widespread deep-sea deposit.
2. It is particularly extensive in the deep Pacific.
3. It is formed mainly from lime shells in warm shallow seas.
Which of the above statements are correct?
n41edf327757.x: Red clay, made of fine inorganic clay and volcanic dust, is the most widespread deep-sea deposit and is most extensive in the deep Pacific; it is not formed from lime shells.

nad10eb78d25.s:
Consider the following statements about India's Deep Ocean Mission:
1. It was approved in June 2021 with an outlay of Rs 4,077 crore.
2. It is implemented by the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nad10eb78d25.x: The Deep Ocean Mission was approved in June 2021 at Rs 4,077 crore and is run by the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES).

n991fe95edc1.s: Ocean salinity is generally expressed in:
n991fe95edc1.x: Salinity is expressed in parts per thousand (per mille, ‰) and also in Practical Salinity Units (PSU).

ngeneral-geography-10-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Thermocline – Rapid salinity change with depth
Halocline – Rapid density change with depth
Pycnocline – Rapid density change with depth
Isohalines – Rapid temperature change with depth
ngeneral-geography-10-4.x: The pycnocline is a zone of rapid density change with depth; the thermocline marks temperature change, the halocline salinity change, and isohalines join places of equal salinity.

nad884bab625.s: The OMNI deep-sea buoys, operated through the NIOT satellite station at Nellore, record which parameters in real time?
nad884bab625.x: The OMNI buoys record temperature, salinity and ocean currents in real time for cyclone and Indian Ocean Dipole forecasting.

o: Barrages across estuaries and underwater turbines
nc272502aec4.x: Tidal energy uses tidal-range systems such as barrages across estuaries and tidal-stream systems using underwater turbines.

n0c7c0f70a6b.s: Which of the following pairs (type of tide – characteristic) is correctly matched?
o: Semi-diurnal – One high tide and one low tide a day
n0c7c0f70a6b.x: Spring tides have the highest tidal range. Semi-diurnal tides have two highs and two lows a day, diurnal tides one of each, and mixed tides are unequal in height.

ngeneral-geography-12-3.s: Which of the following pairs (ocean current – location) is correctly matched?
o: Humboldt – Pacific, west coast of South America
ngeneral-geography-12-3.x: The Humboldt (Peru) Current flows off western South America; the Agulhas runs off south-east Africa, the Benguela off south-west Africa and the Gulf Stream in the North Atlantic.

n11b65fe1072.s:
Consider the following statements about the southwest monsoon season:
1. Circulation in the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal is clockwise.
2. The West India Coastal Current flows southward.
3. The East India Coastal Current flows southward.
Which of the above statements are correct?
n11b65fe1072.x: During the southwest monsoon the circulation is clockwise, the WICC flows southward and the EICC flows northward, so statement 3 is wrong.

ndbdfd680c32.s: Upwelling of cold, nutrient-rich water is particularly important for fisheries along the coasts of:
ndbdfd680c32.x: Cold, nutrient-rich upwelling supports fisheries along Peru and near Somalia, where the Somali (Findlater) current system is involved.

n5c42993799f.s: The usual effect of El Nino on the Indian summer monsoon is that it:
o: Brings the monsoon early with normal rainfall
Has no relationship with the monsoon
n5c42993799f.x: El Nino is generally associated with a delayed and weakened Indian monsoon and a higher risk of deficient rainfall.

n13d764208b5.s: The Madden-Julian Oscillation (MJO) contributes to which feature of the Indian monsoon?
n13d764208b5.x: By shifting the zone of heavy rain eastward, the MJO contributes to active and break spells of the monsoon.

ncf944aca13e.s: Coral reefs are called the 'Rainforests of the Sea' mainly because of their:
o: Large share of the ocean floor
ncf944aca13e.x: Coral reefs cover less than one per cent of the ocean floor but support more than 25 per cent of all marine species.

na4e09932e26.s: Coastal upwelling brings cold, nutrient-rich water to the surface when:
o: Winds pile surface water against the coast
Rivers add fresh water at the coast
Warm surface water sinks due to evaporation
na4e09932e26.x: Coastal upwelling occurs when winds drive surface water away from the coast, allowing cold, nutrient-rich subsurface water to rise.

nccc4672e07f.s: Cold temperate seas are more vulnerable to ocean acidification mainly because cold water has:
nccc4672e07f.x: Carbon dioxide is more soluble in cold water, making cold temperate seas particularly vulnerable to acidification.

nef0672e8c48.s: El Nino can cause a collapse of the Peru fishery because it:
o: Cools the sea surface off Peru
Increases nutrient supply to coastal waters
Suppresses the Peru upwelling, reducing phytoplankton
nef0672e8c48.x: El Nino suppresses the Peru upwelling system, reducing phytoplankton and thereby fish food, which contributes to fishery collapse.

n9ee49907165.s:
Consider the following statements about the coral–zooxanthellae association:
1. Zooxanthellae supply food and colour to corals.
2. Corals provide zooxanthellae with shelter and nutrients.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n9ee49907165.x: Zooxanthellae photosynthesise and supply food and colour to corals, while the coral gives them shelter and nutrients - a mutualistic association.

n600138c00a5.s: Coral reefs are absent along most of India's east coast mainly because of:
o: Heavy river sediment and freshwater input
n600138c00a5.x: Most of the east coast (West Bengal, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh) lacks reefs because heavy river sediment and freshwater inhibit coral growth.

n548b6b8e9c0.s:
Consider the following statements about the Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve:
1. It is India's first marine biosphere reserve.
2. It is located on the Andhra coast.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n548b6b8e9c0.x: The Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve is India's first marine biosphere reserve, with coral reefs, mangroves, seagrass beds and dugongs; it is not on the Andhra coast.

n55770a90906.s: The NGT's clearance of the ₹92,000-crore Great Nicobar project directed the Environment Ministry to:
o: Suspend marine research in the Nicobar Islands
Hand coral protection to the Fisheries Ministry
Translocate all coral reefs before construction
n55770a90906.x: The NGT clearance directed the Environment Ministry to protect and regenerate coral reefs; coral loss was a central objection to the project.

n6e2ed78f6f4.s: Which of the following pairs (global coral bleaching event – period) is correctly matched?
n6e2ed78f6f4.x: The third global bleaching event occurred in 2014–2017; the first was in 1998, the second in 2010 and the fourth from 2023 to about mid-2025.

n352fe4d3c63.s: Since 1998, every strong El Nino has coincided with:
n352fe4d3c63.x: Every strong El Nino since 1998 has coincided with a global coral bleaching event.

nd42b801b431.s: Which is regarded as the strongest global driver of coral loss through bleaching?
o: Rising sea-surface temperature and marine heatwaves
nd42b801b431.x: Rising sea-surface temperature and marine heatwaves are currently the strongest global drivers of coral loss associated with bleaching.

ne631e1c89a8.s:
Consider the following hazard–region associations in India:
1. Cyclones are especially associated with the east coast.
2. Drought is prominent in Rajasthan and the Deccan interior.
3. Landslides are prominent in the Thar Desert.
Which of the above are correct?
ne631e1c89a8.x: Cyclones mark the east coast and drought Rajasthan and the Deccan interior; landslides are associated with the Himalaya and Western Ghats, not the Thar Desert.

n9e45b45e2e3.s: The OMNI buoys that feed India's tsunami warning system are operated by:
n9e45b45e2e3.x: NIOT Nellore's OMNI buoys provide inputs to the tsunami warning system serving the Indian region.

nb034c3aa45b.s: Cloudbursts in the Eastern Ghats agency areas of Andhra Pradesh are especially hazardous because they cause:
nb034c3aa45b.x: Cloudbursts in Andhra Pradesh's Eastern Ghats agency areas can rapidly generate flash floods in narrow valleys.

n68b6bafe114.s: Which combination forms coastal defence against storm surges?
o: Check dams, contour bunds and farm ponds
Mangroves, shelter belts, dune stabilisation and seawalls
n68b6bafe114.x: Mangroves and shelter belts anchor sediment and buffer storm surges, while dune stabilisation and seawalls strengthen coastal defence.

ngeneral-geography-11-13.s: Which of the following pairs (flood type – typical impact) is correctly matched?
ngeneral-geography-11-13.x: Cloudbursts trigger landslides; river floods damage crops, urban floods disrupt infrastructure and dam failure causes catastrophic downstream flooding.

ngeneral-geography-11-10.s: Which areas are highly vulnerable to flash floods?
o: Arid areas with prolonged water deficit
Mountains, steep catchments and urban areas
ngeneral-geography-11-10.x: Flash floods threaten mountains, steep catchments and cities, where water gathers fast; prolonged deficit describes drought.

nd7c3425a92b.s: Severe groundwater depletion in drought-prone Rayalaseema is aggravated by:
nd7c3425a92b.x: Rayalaseema faces monsoon failure, crop loss, distress migration and severe groundwater depletion, aggravated by deep borewells.

nb8e51b1328a.s: Which of the following contributes to the increasing frequency of landslides?
o: Increase in forest cover on slopes
nb8e51b1328a.x: Unregulated construction on unstable slopes increases landslide frequency, along with deforestation, road widening, cloudbursts and deglaciation.

n4e90213c2fa.s: Which of the following pairs (type of drought – meaning) is correctly matched?
o: Hydrological – Soil-moisture deficit causing crop failure
Agricultural – Fall in surface and groundwater
Socio-economic – Water and food shortage hitting livelihoods and markets
Agricultural – Water and food shortage hitting livelihoods
n4e90213c2fa.x: Socio-economic drought is water and food shortage hitting livelihoods and markets; hydrological drought is the fall in surface and groundwater, and agricultural drought is a soil-moisture deficit causing crop failure.

n0cbf3f9d10f.s: The National and State Disaster Mitigation Funds are primarily meant for:
n0cbf3f9d10f.x: The Mitigation Funds are intended for long-term risk reduction and mitigation rather than immediate relief alone.

n21d2c4029af.s: The High Powered Committee on Disaster Management (1999) was chaired by:
n21d2c4029af.x: The High Powered Committee on Disaster Management constituted in 1999 was chaired by J. C. Pant.

ndisaster-management-20-16.s:
Consider the following statements about the High Powered Committee on Disaster Management:
1. It was constituted in 1999.
2. It was chaired by J. C. Pant.
3. It classified disasters into five broad categories.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ndisaster-management-20-16.x: The High Powered Committee (1999, under J. C. Pant) grouped disasters into five broad categories, so all three are correct.

ndisaster-management-17-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: NDMA – Chaired by the Union Home Secretary
NDRF – Policy body chaired by the Prime Minister
National Executive Committee – Operational control through NDMA
ndisaster-management-17-4.x: NIDM is the capacity-building institute under MHA; the NDMA is the PM-chaired policy body, the NDRF works under NDMA control and the NEC is chaired by the Home Secretary.

n04a4f26dd47.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Disaster Response Fund:
1. It is the first fund that every State uses for all local disasters.
2. It is a Central fund that tops up the SDRF during severe calamities.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n04a4f26dd47.x: The NDRF is a Central fund used to supplement the State Disaster Response Fund during severe calamities; it is not the first fund for all local disasters.

n014c0299fd8.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Disaster Response Force:
1. It is a specialist force drawn from central paramilitary forces.
2. It includes search-and-rescue teams, engineers and dog squads.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n014c0299fd8.x: The NDRF is a specialist force drawn from central paramilitary forces, with search-and-rescue teams, engineers and dog squads, under the superintendence of NDMA.

ndisaster-management-15-9.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the NDRF is correctly matched?
o: Raising Day – Aapada Seva Sadaiv Sarvatra
Meaning of the motto – World's largest dedicated disaster response force
ndisaster-management-15-9.x: NDRF Raising Day is 19 January; its motto 'Aapada Seva Sadaiv Sarvatra' means 'Disaster Service Always Everywhere'.

nbed6441a223.s: Which set lists cyclone risk-reduction measures used in Andhra Pradesh?
o: IMD warnings, cyclone shelters, evacuation, shelter belts and mangroves
nbed6441a223.x: Cyclone risk reduction includes IMD warnings, shelters, evacuation, shelter belts and mangrove protection or restoration.

ndisaster-management-3-7.s: Which of the following pairs (institution – location) is correctly matched?
o: Centre for Disaster Management – LBSNAA, Mussoorie
ndisaster-management-3-7.x: The Centre for Disaster Management is at LBSNAA, Mussoorie; the NDRF Academy is in Nagpur, GSI is headquartered in Kolkata and INCOIS is in Hyderabad.

ndisaster-management-26-4.s: Which of the following pairs (hazard – GIS application) is correctly matched?
ndisaster-management-26-4.x: GIS models storm surges for cyclones; it maps flood inundation, assesses agricultural drought through NADAMS and models tsunami inundation for evacuation planning.

n5c2b559bfec.s: India's Exclusive Economic Zone, about 2.37 million sq km, is the world's:
n5c2b559bfec.x: India's EEZ of about 2.37 million sq km is the world's 18th largest, much of it added by the Andaman-Nicobar and Lakshadweep islands.

n404929dd2aa.s: Chavara, Manavalakurichi and Chatrapur are known for beach placers of:
n404929dd2aa.x: Chavara (Kerala), Manavalakurichi (Tamil Nadu), Chatrapur (Odisha) and the Andhra coast have monazite (thorium) and ilmenite (titanium) beach placers.

nee9e6787cc0.s: Which of the following pairs (India's ISA contract – year) is correctly matched?
o: Polymetallic nodules, Central Indian Ocean Basin – 2016
Polymetallic sulphides, Central and South West Indian Ridge – 2016
Polymetallic nodules, Central Indian Ocean Basin – 15 September 2025
nee9e6787cc0.x: The Central and South West Indian Ridge sulphide contract dates to 2016; the CIOB nodule contract is from 2002 and the Carlsberg Ridge sulphide contract from 15 September 2025.

n75dd2990dff.s:
Consider the following statements about India's fish production:
1. Inland fisheries account for less than 25% of it.
2. Inland fisheries contribute more than 75% of it.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n75dd2990dff.x: Inland fisheries contribute more than 75% of India's fish production.

n110674ced01.s:
Consider the following statements about wasteland:
1. It is degraded land that can be brought under vegetative cover with reasonable effort.
2. It is mapped through satellite-based National Wastelands Monitoring.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n110674ced01.x: Wasteland is degraded land restorable to vegetative cover with reasonable effort, and it is mapped through satellite-based National Wastelands Monitoring.

n56054beff1a.s: Under the Forest Rights Act, 2006, who has the authority to manage, protect and regenerate community forest resources?
n56054beff1a.x: The Forest Rights Act, 2006 gives Gram Sabhas authority over the management, protection and regeneration of community forest resources.

nindian-geography-10-4.s: Which of the following pairs (project – location) is correctly matched?
nindian-geography-10-4.x: Rihand is at Sonbhadra in Uttar Pradesh; Hirakud is in Odisha, Idukki in Kerala and Kalpong in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

nindian-geography-51-8.s: Which of the following pairs (dam – river) is correctly matched?
nindian-geography-51-8.x: Hirakud is on the Mahanadi; Indira Sagar is on the Narmada, Tehri on the Bhagirathi and Bhakra-Nangal on the Sutlej.

n185b74bd006.s: Which are the two landlocked countries of South America?
n185b74bd006.x: Bolivia and Paraguay are the landlocked countries of South America.

nb4648d5ce1f.s: In Richard Bass's Seven Summits list, the highest peak of Australia/Oceania is:
nb4648d5ce1f.x: The Bass list uses Kosciuszko in Australia, whereas the Messner list uses Puncak Jaya in Indonesia.

nworld-geography-12-13.s:
Consider the following statements about European mountains:
1. Mont Blanc is the highest peak of the Alps.
2. Elbrus is the highest peak of the Caucasus.
3. The Alps are young fold mountains.
Which of the above statements are correct?
nworld-geography-12-13.x: All three are correct: Mont Blanc tops the Alps, Elbrus tops the Caucasus, and the Alps are young fold mountains.

nworld-geography-12-19.s: Which of the following pairs (peak – location) is correctly matched?
nworld-geography-12-19.x: Mount Cook is in the Southern Alps; Aconcagua is in the Argentine Andes, Kilimanjaro in Africa and Mont Blanc in Europe.

nworld-geography-12-14.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Altai Mountains are a major range in Asia.
2. The Atlas, Drakensberg and Ruwenzori are major ranges in Africa.
3. Mount Kilimanjaro is located in Tanzania.
Which of the above statements are correct?
nworld-geography-12-14.x: All three are correct: the Altai is an Asian range, the Atlas, Drakensberg and Ruwenzori are African, and Kilimanjaro is in Tanzania.

n47b08c648c9.s: Mo Chhu joins Pho Chhu at Punakha in Bhutan; the combined river is known as the:
n47b08c648c9.x: Mo Chhu joins Pho Chhu at Punakha, and the resulting river is the Sankosh.

n74e5a1ee8b9.s: The Dnieper rises in the ____ and drains into the ____.
n74e5a1ee8b9.x: The Dnieper rises in Russia's Valdai Hills and drains into the Black Sea.

n07f64c32ae3.s:
Consider the following statements about the Red Sea:
1. It has no major river inflow.
2. The Dahlak Archipelago lies near its Eritrean coast.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n07f64c32ae3.x: The Red Sea has no major river inflow, and the Dahlak Archipelago lies off Eritrea on its western side.

n169b7d6ff21.s: Which set lists rivers that all flow into the Mediterranean Sea?
n169b7d6ff21.x: The Nile, Rhone, Po and Ebro all flow into the Mediterranean Sea.

nworld-geography-8-19.s: Which of the following pairs (river – mouth) is correctly matched?
nworld-geography-8-19.x: The Niger enters the Atlantic through the Gulf of Guinea; the Dnieper enters the Black Sea, the Volga the Caspian and the Yangtze the East China Sea.

nworld-geography-8-4.s: Which of the following pairs (river – mouth) is correctly matched?
nworld-geography-8-4.x: The Volga drains into the Caspian Sea; the Zambezi enters the Indian Ocean, the Danube the Black Sea and the Thames the North Sea.

nindian-geography-37-12.s: Phulhar Lake is the source of which river?
nindian-geography-37-12.x: Phulhar Lake is the source of the Gomati.

n8a169d85ee4.s:
Arrange the following islands in descending order of area:
A. Madagascar
B. Greenland
C. Borneo
D. New Guinea
n8a169d85ee4.x: The order by area is Greenland, New Guinea, Borneo and Madagascar.

nworld-geography-23-8.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Kalimantan – Shared by Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei
Borneo – Indonesian part of the island
nworld-geography-23-8.x: Kalimantan is the Indonesian part of Borneo; Borneo itself is shared by Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei and covers about 743,000 km².
